name: emw-subset-ts
label: EMwrap Subset TS
help: Create a subset of a tilt-series, tomogram, or particle/coordinate set by selecting tomogram names (rlnTomoName). The subset can be picked in three ways (see 'Selection mode' below): an explicit list of names, matching the names present in a second set, or a random selection of N tomograms. Optionally, individual tilts can also be excluded from specific tomograms' tilt-series metadata.

params.name: input_set
params.label: Input set:
params.pointerClass: TiltSeriesMovies, TiltSeries, TiltSeriesAligned, Tomograms, TomoParticles, TomoCoordinates
params.help: Input STAR file: tilt_series.star, tomograms.star, or optimisation_set.star (TomoParticles / TomoCoordinates).

params.name: warp_previous_job
params.label: Previous job is a Warp job
params.help: Enable when the input set comes from a Warp-based EMHub job. The subset job will preserve the Warp working structure and synchronize Warp's internal selection with this subset so that subsequent Warp jobs can continue from this output.

params.name: mode
params.label: Selection mode

choices.1: Match names from a second set

params.help:
How to choose the rlnTomoName values to keep:

*Explicit tomogram names list*: provide the names directly in 'Subset Tomo Names' below.
*Match names from a second set*: keep the tomograms from the input set whose rlnTomoName is also present in another STAR file (matched by the 'rlnTomoName' column).
*Random selection of N tomograms*: randomly pick N tomograms out of the ones present in the input set.

params.name: subset_tomo_names
params.label: Subset Tomo Names
params.help: Space-separated list of rlnTomoName values to keep in the output set. Can be left empty if 'Exclude Tilts' below is used instead: in that case every tomogram from the input set is kept, and only the requested tilts are excluded.

params.name: subset_match_set
params.label: Second set (match by rlnTomoName):
params.pointerClass: TiltSeriesMovies, TiltSeries, TiltSeriesAligned, Tomograms, TomoParticles, TomoCoordinates
params.help: Another STAR file containing an 'rlnTomoName' column (e.g. a tilt_series.star, tomograms.star, optimisation_set.star, or particles.star). The output subset will keep the tomograms from 'Input set' above whose rlnTomoName also appears in this second set.

params.name: subset_random_count
params.label: Number of tomograms (N)
params.help: Number of tomograms to randomly select from the input set.

params.name: subset_random_seed
params.label: Random seed (optional)
params.help: Optional seed for the random selection, so the same subset can be reproduced across runs. Leave empty to select a different random subset each time.

params.name: exclude_tilts
params.label: Exclude Tilts
params.help: Optional: for one or more tomograms in the subset above, exclude individual tilts from their tilt-series STAR file (the file referenced by the 'rlnTomoTiltSeriesStarFile' column). When at least one row is provided here, the job rewrites that per-tomogram STAR file for each listed tomogram, dropping the rows for the excluded tilts, and points the output 'rlnTomoTiltSeriesStarFile' at the rewritten file instead of the original. Every other tomogram in the subset (not listed here) keeps all its tilts, but its tilt-series STAR file is still copied as-is into this job's own output folder, so that all rows in the output set point to metadata files living in the same job folder. Not available in 'Random selection' mode, since the tomogram names are not known until the job runs.

params.name: tomoName
params.label: Tomo name
params.help: rlnTomoName of the tomogram to exclude tilts from. Must be one of the names that end up in the output subset (the explicit list in Mode 0, or the matched names in Mode 1).

params.name: excludedTilts
params.label: Excluded tilts
params.help: rlnTomoTiltMovieIndex value(s) to exclude from this tomogram's tilt-series STAR file. Separate multiple values with spaces, commas, or both, and use inclusive ranges written as 'start-end' (e.g. '3 5, 9' or '5-9, 12' for tilts 5 through 9 plus 12).
